title: Patch: one shared draw for every random enemy permanent
thread:
**Issue #4763 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4763: Patch: one shared draw for every random enemy permanent
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means

Several cards say "a random enemy permanent": bounce two of them, exile some of them, steal one, and so on. Each card's code builds that draw its own way today, and four past bugs came from a draw that reached a card it should have passed by (a sleeping card, usually). After this change there is one shared draw every such card uses, so the next card like them cannot pick the wrong pool. Players notice nothing except fewer weird one-off bugs; card authors copy one line instead of a paragraph.

## Why

The same pool-choice bug class shipped four times, each fixed ad hoc in its own script or verb: R4322000 (MC Tech counted and drew a Dormant card), R4424000 (Arcane Missiles drew Units immune to Spells; Unlicensed Experimentation and an Embiggened Transmogulate matched Dormant cards), R4524000 (Black Hole swallowed a pile holding a Dormant card beneath a Stack card), R4555000 (Mega Church's wide Tribute paid with a Dormant Field Spell). The draws still spell the pool three ways: `query::enemy_permanents` plus a manual pick (Snom Bunny, MC Tech), `cards_in_scope` with side enemy and rows units plus backrow plus shuffle-and-take (Mid Runner, Reach the Summit), and `cards_in_scope` plus `rng.pick` in a loop (Exile). Reach the Summit and Exile even define their own local `enemy_permanents()` scope helpers. The engine already centralizes board-wide walks on `cards_in_scope` ("defined once here, and each board-wide verb is a thin walk over it") and already ships random verbs (`damage_random_enemies`, `buff_random_unit`); the enemy-permanent draw is the remaining hand-rolled one. Everything is guarded today (I19, I22, and `unaffected_by` passing slumbering cards by), so this is prevention plus less code, not a live-bug fix.

## Proposal

Add one engine verb beside `buff_random_unit` in `effects/random_picks.rs`: draw N distinct random enemy permanents from the reach-checked pool (R60 distinct picks, R129 empty pool draws nothing, R13 pile tops and backrow with face-down cards included and Dormant cards passed by), with the rng roll inside the effect as that module requires. Migrate the five call sites to it (Mid Runner, Reach the Summit, Exile, Snom Bunny, MC Tech), keeping each call site's own extra filters (such as Snom Bunny's slash-awareness) and pick timing; only the pool construction is shared. Add no new lint or check: reviewers hold the convention as they do for `cards_in_scope` today. Sequence after #4737/#4760 lands, since that work is changing scope semantics under the same helpers.

## Where it lands

`crates/engine/src/effects/random_picks.rs` (new verb and its tests) beside `split.rs`'s `damage_random_enemies` precedent; the five scripts `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c022_mid_runner.rs`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/meditative/c008_reach_the_summit.rs`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c010_exile.rs`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c025_snom_bunny.rs`, `crates/cards/src/scripts/classic/c040_mc_tech.rs` (each file's existing tests hold the behavior); SPEC sections 3.2, 6.1 Dormant, and the five cards' section 8 rows; rulings R13, R60, R129, R3550009, R4322000, R4424000 already cover the semantics, so no new ruling is expected.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The new verb has tests: N distinct ids from a mixed board, nothing drawn from an empty pool, Dormant cards never drawn, face-down cards drawable, slash-half boards handled.
- [ ] Each migrated card's existing tests pass unchanged, including the R60/R13/R841/R404/R3554003 cases.
- [ ] The fuzz monitor's I19 and I22 stay green on seeds covering those cards.
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`, and the engine rules tests plus the cards tests pass.

## Size and risks

Medium: one new verb with tests plus five small script migrations. The main risk is subtle set differences between today's three spellings (ordering, carried or standing Units, slash-awareness); the proposal shares only pool construction and keeps every call site's filters, with the existing card tests pinning behavior. Build it after #4737/#4760 to avoid conflicting with the in-flight scope fix.
```
